description: 面向运维与运营的龙虾集群态势总览，所有累计值均随当前时间选择器变化。

panels.title: 核心态势 · 当前选定区间
OTel 活跃龙虾
panels.description: Collector 当前仍在暴露该 Gateway 的 OTel resource。

targets.expr: count((max by (gateway_id) (target_info{job="openclaw-gateway"})) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"}))) or vector(0)
count(max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Prometheus 直抓在线
panels.description: 原生 diagnostics-prometheus 抓取状态；不影响 OTel 已回流的运营数据。

targets.expr: sum(max by (cluster, gateway_id) (up{job="openclaw-gateways",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"})) or vector(0)

sum((increase(openclaw_tokens_total{job="openclaw-gateway",openclaw_token="total"}[$__range])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"}))) or vector(0)

sum((increase(openclaw_model_call_duration_ms_milliseconds_count{job="openclaw-gateway"}[$__range])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: 会话轮次
panels.description: OpenClaw 不导出原始 session ID，因此以 session.turn.created 作为可聚合的会话工作量口径。

targets.expr: sum((increase(openclaw_session_turn_created_total{job="openclaw-gateway"}[$__range])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"}))) or vector(0)

panels.title: 模型成本
panels.description: 仅展示 OpenClaw 实际导出的 cost，不使用本系统自建价格账本。

targets.expr: sum((increase(openclaw_cost_usd_total{job="openclaw-gateway"}[$__range])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"}))) or vector(0)

(sum((increase(openclaw_model_call_duration_ms_milliseconds_count{job="openclaw-gateway",openclaw_error_category=~".+"}[$__range])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"}))) / clamp_min(sum((increase(openclaw_model_call_duration_ms_milliseconds_count{job="openclaw-gateway"}[$__range])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"}))), 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Token 消耗 · 构成、趋势与排名
Token 构成
panels.description: 构成图排除 total 和派生的 prompt，避免包含关系重复相加。

targets.expr: sum by (openclaw_token) ((increase(openclaw_tokens_total{job="openclaw-gateway",openclaw_token=~"input|output|cache_read|cache_write|reasoning"}[$__range])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"})))

sum by (openclaw_token) ((rate(openclaw_tokens_total{job="openclaw-gateway",openclaw_token=~"input|output|cache_read|cache_write|reasoning"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"})))

topk(15, (sum by (gateway_id) ((increase(openclaw_tokens_total{job="openclaw-gateway",openclaw_token="total"}[$__range])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"})))) * on (gateway_id) group_left(cluster, lobster_name, server_display_id) (0 * (max by (cluster, gateway_id, lobster_name, server_display_id, department) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"})) + 1))

topk(15, sum by (openclaw_provider, openclaw_model) ((increase(openclaw_tokens_total{job="openclaw-gateway",openclaw_token="total"}[$__range])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"}))))

topk(15, sum by (openclaw_provider) ((increase(openclaw_tokens_total{job="openclaw-gateway",openclaw_token="total"}[$__range])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"}))))

panels.title: 模型与 Provider · 调用、成本、时延与错误

targets.expr: sum((rate(openclaw_model_call_duration_ms_milliseconds_count{job="openclaw-gateway"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"}))) * 60

sum((rate(openclaw_model_call_duration_ms_milliseconds_count{job="openclaw-gateway",openclaw_error_category=~".+"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"}))) * 60

sum by (openclaw_provider) ((increase(openclaw_model_call_duration_ms_milliseconds_count{job="openclaw-gateway"}[$__range])) and on (gateway_id) (max by (gateway_id) (agentswatch_gateway_info{inventory_state="active",cluster=~"$cluster",department=~"$department",region=~"$region",team=~"$team"})))
